# compose-api-client

> Generated clients for the compose-api.

**Group:** Verification / BSVS era · **PRs since 2022-09:** 4 (all dependency automation) · **Active span:** 2026-03 – 2026-05 · **Key contributors:** (auto-generated; maintained by the compose-api team)

## Project background
`compose-api-client` holds **auto-generated client libraries** for the `compose-api` server — i.e., typed SDKs produced from the API's OpenAPI specification so that other tools (and users) can call the compose-api programmatically without hand-writing HTTP code. It is a thin, generated companion to `compose-api`.

## Timeline (themed milestones)
- **2026-Q1 onward** — Repo created and Renovate configured (#1, 2026-03). All PRs to date are Dependabot dependency bumps (pygments, pytest, idna); the client code itself is regenerated/committed directly from the compose-api spec rather than via feature PRs.

## Notable PRs
None substantive — the repo is generated. See `compose-api` for the API it wraps.

- Maintained alongside `compose-api` (Ezequiel-Valencia, jcschaff); content is generated.
